sub_agendas_items.title: Election of an Interim Chair

attachments.attachment_title: Report - Election of Interim Chair - final.pdf

sub_agendas_items.minutes:
Vice-Chair DeGiovanni presided over the election of the Interim Chair.
Prior to calling for nominations, she explained that, in accordance with section 57 subsection 2 of the Health Protection and Promotion Act, she would request nominations for the position of Interim Chair, to be confirmed at the Board’s first meeting in 2023. 
Following her nomination, Member Kitts accepted the nomination for the position of Interim Chair. 
Vice-Chair DeGiovanni called for any additional nominations three times before calling for a motion to close the nominations. 
Following her election as Interim Chair, Chair Kitts took over as presiding officer and chaired the balance of the meeting.

motions.motion_text: That the Board of Health for the City of Ottawa Health Unit elect an Interim Chair, to be confirmed at the first meeting of 2023, as required by theHealth Protection and Promotion Act.

That Member Kitts be nominated for the position of Interim Chair for the Board of Health for the City of Ottawa Health Unit, to be confirmed at the first meeting of the Board of Health in 2023 pursuant to Section 57, subsection 2 of the Health Protection and Promotion Act.
That nominations for the position of Interim Chair be closed.

That Member Kitts be appointed as Interim Chair for the Board of Health for the City of Ottawa Health Unit, to be confirmed at the first meeting of the Board of Health in 2023 pursuant to Section 57, subsection 2 of the Health Protection and Promotion Act.

sub_agendas_items.title: Medical Officer of Health Verbal Report
sub_agendas_items.minutes:
Dr. Etches began her verbal report by welcoming the newly appointed Council Members to the Board of Health. She then provided updates on the local situation as relates to COVID-19 and other respiratory illnesses, work on childhood immunization, and the budget development process. She also talked about plans for the new year as relates to Board Members’ orientation and the strategic planning process. In closing, she talked about the holidays and things everyone can do to protect themselves and their loved ones from the most serious effects of respiratory illnesses and she wished everyone a happy, healthy holiday season. 
In the context of the Medical Officer of Health Verbal Report, the Board heard from one (1) public delegation - Mr. Greg Macdougall. Mr. Macdougall also provided a written submission, which was circulated to Board of Health Members in advance of the meeting and is held on file with the Board of Health Secretary. 
After hearing from the public delegation, Dr. Etches and staff responded to questions from Members of the Board of Health. 
The Board then voted to receive the Medical Officer of Health's Verbal Report. Discussions on this item lasted approximately 30 minutes.

motions.motion_text: That the Board of Health for the City of Ottawa Health Unit receive this verbal report for information.
